country.description: Two-letter ISO code representing the buyer's country. Values are provided by PayPal directly (if supported) at the time of authorization or settlement. They cannot be set or mutated.

payer_email.description:
Owner's email. Values are provided by PayPal directly
(if supported) at the time of authorization or settlement. They cannot be set or mutated.

payer_id.description: PayPal account PayerID. This identifier uniquely identifies the PayPal customer.
